page_topic_one_liner: AI coding agents — autonomous multi-step planning, file edits, and feature implementation
differentiator_vs_generic: Agent task panel with numbered plan checklist and live file edit diffs, NOT passive inline completion or no-code drag-drop builder.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Coding agent workspace — left task plan checklist with checked steps, right split editor showing multi-file diff patches applying in sequence
Compact prompt card with blurred feature request arrow into agent plan header
2x2 grid of agent output vignettes (bug fix patch, new API route, test suite, refactor diff) — diff fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on one applied file change block in the agent editor
anti_patterns: PR review comment panel as sole hero
